Explanation of Meeting Procedure
(i)  Applicant's Presentation
The applicant, or a representative, will be invited by the committee to provide details of the proposed application and its merits.
(ii) Application Correspondence
The chair will invite the Secretary - Treasurer to present any correspondence received for the application being considered.
(iii) Member Participation
The members of the committee will be invited to address the applicant and ask questions relevant to the application.
(iv) Public Participation
The public will be invited to address the Committee to provide comments in support of or opposition to the application.
(v) Further Action
Following the question period, the committee may then make a decision regarding the application, to defer consideration of the application, to defer consideration of the application, reserve its decision or adjourn the meeting, should the committee make a decision approving or refusing the application, The Secretary Treasurer shall issue written Notice of Decision subject to the requirements of the Planning Act upon issuance of the decision a 20 day appeal period is initiated during which the applicant, the minister or a specified person or public body that has no interest in the matter may appeal the decision of the Committee of Adjustment to the Ontario Land Tribunal.
